    year = context['period']
    state = context['state']
    iteration = state.get('iteration', 0) if state.get('year') == year else 0
    prior = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    authors = sorted([a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']])
    if not authors:

    primary = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration) % len(authors)]

    recipients = [primary, peer] if paired else [primary]
    papers = world['papers']['papers'][:3]
    paper_ids = [p['id'] for p in papers]
    title = str(papers[0].get('title', 'a recorded scientific claim')) if papers else 'a falsifiable scientific claim'
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': 'clinic-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id': actor, 'action': action, 'payload': payload}})
    if prior is None and iteration == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id': 'cooperative', 'type': 'open-cooperative',
            'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': 0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (prior['revision'] if prior else 0) + iteration
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id': 'cooperative', 'expected_revision': revision,
        'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': revision + 1, 'last_year': year,
            'process': 'evidence-clinic', 'recipients': recipients, 'paper_ids': paper_ids}})

    protocol = {'institution': 'evidence-clinic', 'primary': primary, 'skeptical_peer': peer if paired else None,

        'hypothesis': 'Identify a concrete recorded claim and a condition under which it fails.',
        'verification': ['State a falsifiable prediction before proposing the study.',
            'Separate replication evidence from a new conjecture.',
            'Specify one negative control and one reproducibility check.'],
        'division_of_labor': 'Primary proposes a test; skeptical peer challenges the test, without asserting that either result is known.' if paired else 'Primary specifies both a test and an explicit alternative explanation.'}

        'owner_actor': 'cooperative', 'content': protocol, 'actor_ids': ['cooperative'] + recipients,
        'artifact_ids': [], 'native_paper_ids': paper_ids})
    for position, actor in enumerate(recipients):
        emit('input-' + str(position), 'native.context', {'actor_ids': [actor],
            'content': {'proposal': 'EVIDENCE_CLINIC_V7: use the attached protocol to make the next scientific plan falsifiable.',

                'counterpart_actor': peer if position == 0 and paired else primary if paired else None,
                'protocol': protocol, 'iteration': iteration}, 'artifact_ids': [record_id]})
    if iteration == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment': {'actor_id': primary,
            'direction': {'topic': 'Replication and stress-testing: ' + title[:100],
                'focus_areas': ['falsifiable prediction', 'negative controls', 'reproducibility'],
                'years': 1, 'keywords': ['replication', 'robustness', 'scientific methods'], 'related_topics': []},
            'detailed_focus': 'EVIDENCE_CLINIC_V7: choose an explicit claim from the supplied native paper records, specify a failure condition and negative control, and distinguish observed results from proposed tests.',
            'reason': 'A code-defined persistent evidence clinic allocates an annual replication project using actual native paper identities.',
            'project_start_year': year, 'project_end_year': year}})
    return {'outputs': {'commands': commands},
        'state': {'year': year, 'iteration': iteration + 1, 'last_protocol': record_id}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    state = context['state']
    iteration = state.get('iteration', 0) if state.get('year') == year else 0
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    authors = sorted([a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']])
    if not authors:
        raise ValueError('review response clinic requires actual native authors')
    mode = context['parameters']['recipient_mode']
    primary = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration) % len(authors)]
    peer = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration + 1) % len(authors)]
    papers = [p for p in world['papers']['papers'] if p.get('author_id') in authors]
    reviewed = [p for p in papers if p.get('review_history')]
    if mode == 'review-response-network' and reviewed:
        ordered = sorted(reviewed, key=lambda p: (p['review_history'][-1].get('decision') != 'reject',
            p['review_history'][-1].get('score', 0.0), p['id']))
        chosen = ordered[iteration % len(ordered)]
        primary = chosen['author_id']
        possible_peers = [r.get('reviewer_id') for r in chosen['review_history'][-1].get('reviews', [])
            if r.get('reviewer_id') in authors and r.get('reviewer_id') != primary]
        peer = possible_peers[0] if possible_peers else authors[(authors.index(primary) + 1) % len(authors)]
    else:
        owned = [p for p in papers if p.get('author_id') == primary]
        available = owned if owned else papers
        chosen = available[iteration % len(available)] if available else None
    paired = mode != 'single-desk' and peer != primary
    recipients = [primary, peer] if paired else [primary]
    history = chosen.get('review_history', []) if chosen else []
    latest = history[-1] if history else {}
    criticisms = [str(r.get('justification', ''))[:650] for r in latest.get('reviews', [])][:3]
    paper_ids = [chosen['id']] if chosen else []
    title = str(chosen.get('title', 'a recorded scientific claim')) if chosen else None
    protocol = {'institution': 'review-response-clinic', 'mode': mode, 'primary': primary,
        'skeptical_peer': peer if paired else None, 'paper_ids': paper_ids, 'claim_title': title,
        'observed_review_decision': latest.get('decision'), 'observed_review_score': latest.get('score'),
        'observed_criticisms': criticisms, 'evidence_available': chosen is not None,
        'required_response': ['Map each available criticism to a specific proposed test or a precise limitation.',
            'State one falsifiable prediction, one alternative explanation and one negative control.',
            'Do not claim a test was run or criticism resolved merely because a revision was proposed.'],
        'bootstrap_instruction': 'When no native paper exists yet, retain the researcher-chosen topic and define what evidence would disconfirm it.'}
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': 'response-clinic-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id': actor, 'action': action, 'payload': payload}})
    if old is None and iteration == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id': 'cooperative', 'type': 'open-cooperative',
            'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': 0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + iteration
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id': 'cooperative', 'expected_revision': revision,
        'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': revision + 1, 'last_year': year,
            'process': 'review-response-clinic', 'recipients': recipients, 'paper_ids': paper_ids,
            'observed_criticisms': criticisms, 'evidence_available': chosen is not None}})
    record_id = 'review-response-protocol-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id': record_id, 'type': 'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor': 'cooperative', 'content': protocol, 'actor_ids': ['cooperative'] + recipients,
        'artifact_ids': [], 'native_paper_ids': paper_ids})
    for position, actor in enumerate(recipients):
        emit('input-' + str(position), 'native.context', {'actor_ids': [actor],
            'content': {'proposal': 'REVIEW_RESPONSE_CLINIC_V7: turn observed methodological criticisms into explicit proposed tests, without asserting unobserved success.',
                'role': 'revision test designer' if position == 0 else 'skeptical review-to-test partner',
                'counterpart_actor': peer if position == 0 and paired else primary if paired else None,
                'protocol': protocol, 'iteration': iteration}, 'artifact_ids': [record_id]})
    if iteration == 0 and chosen is not None:
        gaps = ' | '.join(criticisms) if criticisms else 'No review criticism is recorded; identify an explicit falsifiable gap before claiming novelty.'
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment': {'actor_id': primary,
            'direction': {'topic': 'Evidence-led revision and stress-test: ' + title[:100],
                'focus_areas': ['review-grounded test design', 'negative controls', 'empirical validation'],
                'years': 1, 'keywords': ['revision', 'replication', 'validation'], 'related_topics': []},
            'detailed_focus': 'REVIEW_RESPONSE_CLINIC_V7: use the actual native record ' + chosen['id'] + '. Observed critiques: ' + gaps + ' Propose concrete tests and state limitations; no results are implied.',
            'reason': 'A persistent code-authored institution uses prior native scientific artifacts and review feedback, rather than a generic topic replacement.',
            'project_start_year': year, 'project_end_year': year}})
    return {'outputs': {'commands': commands}, 'state': {'year': year, 'iteration': iteration + 1,
        'last_protocol': record_id, 'last_paper_ids': paper_ids}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    state = context['state']
    iteration = state.get('iteration', 0) if state.get('year') == year else 0
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    authors = sorted([a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']])
    if not authors:
        raise ValueError('review response clinic requires actual native authors')
    mode = context['parameters']['recipient_mode']
    primary = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration) % len(authors)]
    peer = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration + 1) % len(authors)]
    papers = [p for p in world['papers']['papers'] if p.get('author_id') in authors]
    reviewed = [p for p in papers if p.get('review_history')]
    if mode == 'review-response-network' and reviewed:
        ordered = sorted(reviewed, key=lambda p: (p['review_history'][-1].get('decision') != 'reject',
            p['review_history'][-1].get('score', 0.0), p['id']))
        chosen = ordered[iteration % len(ordered)]
        primary = chosen['author_id']
        possible_peers = [r.get('reviewer_id') for r in chosen['review_history'][-1].get('reviews', [])
            if r.get('reviewer_id') in authors and r.get('reviewer_id') != primary]
        peer = possible_peers[0] if possible_peers else authors[(authors.index(primary) + 1) % len(authors)]
    else:
        owned = [p for p in papers if p.get('author_id') == primary]
        available = owned if owned else papers
        chosen = available[iteration % len(available)] if available else None
    paired = mode != 'single-desk' and peer != primary
    recipients = [primary, peer] if paired else [primary]
    history = chosen.get('review_history', []) if chosen else []
    latest = history[-1] if history else {}
    criticisms = [str(r.get('justification', ''))[:650] for r in latest.get('reviews', [])][:3]
    paper_ids = [chosen['id']] if chosen else []
    title = str(chosen.get('title', 'a recorded scientific claim')) if chosen else None
    protocol = {'institution': 'review-response-clinic', 'mode': mode, 'primary': primary,
        'skeptical_peer': peer if paired else None, 'paper_ids': paper_ids, 'claim_title': title,
        'observed_review_decision': latest.get('decision'), 'observed_review_score': latest.get('score'),
        'observed_criticisms': criticisms, 'evidence_available': chosen is not None,
        'required_response': ['Map each available criticism to a specific proposed test or a precise limitation.',
            'State one falsifiable prediction, one alternative explanation and one negative control.',
            'Do not claim a test was run or criticism resolved merely because a revision was proposed.'],
        'bootstrap_instruction': 'When no native paper exists yet, retain the researcher-chosen topic and define what evidence would disconfirm it.'}
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': 'response-clinic-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id': actor, 'action': action, 'payload': payload}})
    if old is None and iteration == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id': 'cooperative', 'type': 'open-cooperative',
            'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': 0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + iteration
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id': 'cooperative', 'expected_revision': revision,
        'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': revision + 1, 'last_year': year,
            'process': 'review-response-clinic', 'recipients': recipients, 'paper_ids': paper_ids,
            'observed_criticisms': criticisms, 'evidence_available': chosen is not None}})
    record_id = 'review-response-protocol-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id': record_id, 'type': 'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor': 'cooperative', 'content': protocol, 'actor_ids': ['cooperative'] + recipients,
        'artifact_ids': [], 'native_paper_ids': paper_ids})
    for position, actor in enumerate(recipients):
        emit('input-' + str(position), 'native.context', {'actor_ids': [actor],
            'content': {'proposal': 'REVIEW_RESPONSE_CLINIC_V7: turn observed methodological criticisms into explicit proposed tests, without asserting unobserved success.',
                'role': 'revision test designer' if position == 0 else 'skeptical review-to-test partner',
                'counterpart_actor': peer if position == 0 and paired else primary if paired else None,
                'protocol': protocol, 'iteration': iteration}, 'artifact_ids': [record_id]})
    if iteration == 0 and chosen is not None:
        gaps = ' | '.join(criticisms) if criticisms else 'No review criticism is recorded; identify an explicit falsifiable gap before claiming novelty.'
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment': {'actor_id': primary,
            'direction': {'topic': 'Evidence-led revision and stress-test: ' + title[:100],
                'focus_areas': ['review-grounded test design', 'negative controls', 'empirical validation'],
                'years': 1, 'keywords': ['revision', 'replication', 'validation'], 'related_topics': []},
            'detailed_focus': 'REVIEW_RESPONSE_CLINIC_V7: use the actual native record ' + chosen['id'] + '. Observed critiques: ' + gaps + ' Propose concrete tests and state limitations; no results are implied.',
            'reason': 'A persistent code-authored institution uses prior native scientific artifacts and review feedback, rather than a generic topic replacement.',
            'project_start_year': year, 'project_end_year': year}})
    return {'outputs': {'commands': commands}, 'state': {'year': year, 'iteration': iteration + 1,
        'last_protocol': record_id, 'last_paper_ids': paper_ids}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    state = context['state']
    iteration = state.get('iteration', 0) if state.get('year') == year else 0
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    authors = sorted([a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']])
    if not authors:
        raise ValueError('review response clinic requires actual native authors')
    mode = context['parameters']['recipient_mode']
    primary = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration) % len(authors)]
    peer = authors[((year - 1) * 2 + iteration + 1) % len(authors)]
    papers = [p for p in world['papers']['papers'] if p.get('author_id') in authors]
    reviewed = [p for p in papers if p.get('review_history')]
    if mode == 'review-response-network' and reviewed:
        ordered = sorted(reviewed, key=lambda p: (p['review_history'][-1].get('decision') != 'reject',
            p['review_history'][-1].get('score', 0.0), p['id']))
        chosen = ordered[iteration % len(ordered)]
        primary = chosen['author_id']
        possible_peers = [r.get('reviewer_id') for r in chosen['review_history'][-1].get('reviews', [])
            if r.get('reviewer_id') in authors and r.get('reviewer_id') != primary]
        peer = possible_peers[0] if possible_peers else authors[(authors.index(primary) + 1) % len(authors)]
    else:
        owned = [p for p in papers if p.get('author_id') == primary]
        available = owned if owned else papers
        chosen = available[iteration % len(available)] if available else None
    paired = mode != 'single-desk' and peer != primary
    recipients = [primary, peer] if paired else [primary]
    history = chosen.get('review_history', []) if chosen else []
    latest = history[-1] if history else {}
    criticisms = [str(r.get('justification', ''))[:650] for r in latest.get('reviews', [])][:3]
    paper_ids = [chosen['id']] if chosen else []
    title = str(chosen.get('title', 'a recorded scientific claim')) if chosen else None
    protocol = {'institution': 'review-response-clinic', 'mode': mode, 'primary': primary,
        'skeptical_peer': peer if paired else None, 'paper_ids': paper_ids, 'claim_title': title,
        'observed_review_decision': latest.get('decision'), 'observed_review_score': latest.get('score'),
        'observed_criticisms': criticisms, 'evidence_available': chosen is not None,
        'required_response': ['Map each available criticism to a specific proposed test or a precise limitation.',
            'State one falsifiable prediction, one alternative explanation and one negative control.',
            'Do not claim a test was run or criticism resolved merely because a revision was proposed.'],
        'bootstrap_instruction': 'When no native paper exists yet, retain the researcher-chosen topic and define what evidence would disconfirm it.'}
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema': 'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': 'response-clinic-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id': actor, 'action': action, 'payload': payload}})
    if old is None and iteration == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id': 'cooperative', 'type': 'open-cooperative',
            'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': 0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + iteration
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id': 'cooperative', 'expected_revision': revision,
        'roles': ['open-planner'], 'state': {'rounds': revision + 1, 'last_year': year,
            'process': 'review-response-clinic', 'recipients': recipients, 'paper_ids': paper_ids,
            'observed_criticisms': criticisms, 'evidence_available': chosen is not None}})
    record_id = 'review-response-protocol-' + str(year) + '-' + str(iteration)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id': record_id, 'type': 'open-protocol-record',

        'artifact_ids': [], 'native_paper_ids': paper_ids})
    for position, actor in enumerate(recipients):

                'role': 'revision test designer' if position == 0 else 'skeptical review-to-test partner',
                'counterpart_actor': peer if position == 0 and paired else primary if paired else None,
                'protocol': protocol, 'iteration': iteration}, 'artifact_ids': [record_id]})
    if iteration == 0 and chosen is not None:
        gaps = ' | '.join(criticisms) if criticisms else 'No review criticism is recorded; identify an explicit falsifiable gap before claiming novelty.'
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment': {'actor_id': primary,
            'direction': {'topic': 'Evidence-led revision and stress-test: ' + title[:100],
                'focus_areas': ['review-grounded test design', 'negative controls', 'empirical validation'],
                'years': 1, 'keywords': ['revision', 'replication', 'validation'], 'related_topics': []},
            'detailed_focus': 'REVIEW_RESPONSE_CLINIC_V7: use the actual native record ' + chosen['id'] + '. Observed critiques: ' + gaps + ' Propose concrete tests and state limitations; no results are implied.',
            'reason': 'A persistent code-authored institution uses prior native scientific artifacts and review feedback, rather than a generic topic replacement.',
            'project_start_year': year, 'project_end_year': year}})
    return {'outputs': {'commands': commands}, 'state': {'year': year, 'iteration': iteration + 1,
        'last_protocol': record_id, 'last_paper_ids': paper_ids}}
